verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official CLI and token-authenticated Admin APIs that let code drive store and app tasks without the admin UI, which supports scripted automation. The evidence never documents non-interactive or CI use, and the 'headless storefront' material is about decoupled frontends, not headless execution, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented CI/non-interactive CLI mode (e.g., env-var or token auth for pipelines), CI integration guides, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Shopify CLI is a command-line interface tool that helps you generate and work with Shopify apps, themes and custom storefronts.
Your code obtains an access token scoped to the permissions it needs.
The Admin API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance the Shopify admin.
Shopify AI Toolkit connects your AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs, API schemas, and CLI store management
